parsed_json.up: Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human MMP-9 (CHEMBL321). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical SMILES. Join docs and use LEFT JOIN compound_records to retrieve compound_key and PubMed ID/DOI. Filter by target CHEMBL321, standard_type IC50, and require both canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id OR doi) to be non-null. Return all requested columns with exact aliases: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
